services.name: Free Student Matinees
services.desc: Applications for October - December are now closed.Applications for January - May Free Student Matinees will be available in November 2026. The Old Globe is committed to making theatre that matters, including making it matter to more youth. Each year, thousands of students gain access to live theatre of the highest quality, as well as a greater appreciation for the art form through our Free Student Matinees (FSM) program. For over 20 years, we have offered transportation and tickets at no cost as well as a free in-classroom pre-show workshop designed to enhance the theatre-going experience lead by our trained, professional Teaching Artists.
